subject: ingen-worker
completion_scope: Source package produced with documented framing deviations. No formal acceptance claimed.

integrity.source_absence: No same-helper source found in readable paths; supplied owner-evidence corroborates. Unreadable unrelated temp directory disclosed in preflight.

self_review.method: Direct inspection of both generated tool outputs; selected local PNG reopened with view_image detail original. Visual landmark estimates are approximate, not segmentation.

selected_attempt_01.adult_original_technician: Visually meets intended adult field-technician identity. Invented face; no actor likeness was targeted. No exhaustive similarity check performed.
selected_attempt_01.outfit: Khaki rolled sleeves, muted olive utility vest, tan full trousers, brown boots; distinct from owner hat/shorts/rifle outfit.
selected_attempt_01.front_orientation: Head, shoulders, torso and hips read straight front; mathematical orthographic projection unverified from raster.
selected_attempt_01.full_figure: All hair, hands, boots, tool and base inside frame; no headgear requested.
selected_attempt_01.pose_and_gaps: Relaxed slightly bent elbows; arms separated from torso; visible background gaps around limbs and tool.
selected_attempt_01.hands: Right hand on viewer left grips downward/outward tool. Left hand on viewer right is empty. Natural grip occludes parts of several fingers; no obvious extra/fused digits or limb loss observed, not anatomically certified.
selected_attempt_01.tool: Compact dark pistol-like launcher; restraint function is an authorized design interpretation and cannot be established by mechanics or visible prop alone.
selected_attempt_01.base: Exactly two stacked dark stone discs, visually nearly edge-on. Thin bright upper rim present; strict zero-visible-top condition remains uncertain.
selected_attempt_01.background: Plain charcoal studio backdrop with soft tonal gradient; no ground environment.
selected_attempt_01.exclusions: No visible text, brand marks, UI, dinosaurs, scenery, extra figures, VFX or fantasy features.

attempt_02.intent: One allowed correction for actual top-margin framing failure.
attempt_02.identity_and_hands: Overall identity, outfit and required right/left tool assignment retained.
attempt_02.reason: More empty space below base and poorer combined framing; attempt 01 selected. No additional correction authorized.

limitations: Three individual live avatar variations remain unmade; a single generic representative reference was produced.
No back/side orthographic sheets, 3D mesh, rig, animation, game import or runtime testing.
Exact projection, zero-visible-top pedestal geometry and perfect hand topology cannot be certified from a generated raster.
Originality and absence of actor resemblance are design intent, not legal or biometric verification.
One unrelated temporary directory was inaccessible during filename/path absence scan.
manifest_policy: manifest-sha256.json includes every file recursively except itself; checked after writing.
